en-US: Build 202 internal device test. New since build 201: (1) post-tool replay/checkpoint memory is bounded for remote and local tool continuations. (2) The IDE discovers nested Git repositories by walking ancestor directories and shows changes as a collapsible directory tree; non-Git workspaces keep an explicit empty state. (3) Office open/save/retry is bounded: a failed open reaches a retryable terminal state, native prepare and every save path sit behind a single-resume deadline gate, and the explicit-save bridge has a bounded watchdog; known residual: a CodeBlitz error-95 toast still needs your device verification. (4) Image files open an editor directly from workspace previews. The GitHub app release for this build will be a normal Latest release, not a prerelease. Validation is intentionally limited to focused code checks plus one cloud App build; full UI/device acceptance is yours. No public beta or App Store production release is included.
zh-Hans: Build 202 内部真机测试。相较 Build 201 的新内容：① 工具后重放／检查点内存已有界，远程与本地工具续跑不再无界累积。② IDE 沿祖先目录发现嵌套 Git 仓库，变更以可折叠目录树展示；非 Git 工作区保留明确空状态。③ Office 打开／保存／重试有界：打开失败进入可重试终止状态，原生 prepare 与全部保存路径受单次恢复截止门约束，显式保存桥接带看门狗；已知残留：CodeBlitz error-95 toast 仍需你真机验证。④ 图片文件可从工作区预览直接进入编辑器。本版 GitHub App 发布将为正常 Latest，不是预发布。本轮验证刻意限定为聚焦代码检查加一次云端 App 构建；完整 UI／真机验收由你完成。本轮不含公开 Beta 或 App Store 生产发布。
